naive.note: Straight-line extrapolation of the observed weekly move (-2.52%/wk) held constant for all 21 weeks to Q1 2027. Treats the whole trailing move as durable -- tends to overreact when the trailing window is short.

dampened.note: Same weekly move applied for 4 more weeks, then held flat through Q1 2027 (17 weeks flat) -- assumes a short trend decelerates rather than continuing unchanged for months.

nfdm_crosscheck.note: NFDM curve prices Q1 2027 at -7.0% vs current spot; applying that same move to WPC80's current price as a dairy-complex cross-check (loose proxy -- different raw stream than NFDM).

qualitative.note: WPC80 is moving opposite WPC34 and dry whey together -- the reallocation pattern USDA's Jun 2026 narrative described (manufacturers shift output between these off the same finite whey stream as WPC80 demand shifts). Documented, product-specific explanation, so this call leans more on WPC80's own trend and less on the generic NFDM cross-check.
